{"invites":[{"spec_id":"spec_0096","text":"Subject: Let's get in a room together!!

Hi Omar, Hector, Dmitri, Nadia, Kenji, Rosa (and Priya's seat is saved for whoever from the volunteer committee can make it!),

Okay, I am SO excited about this one. Can we grab 45 minutes this Thursday, 2:00-2:45, in the big room at the Friends of Willowhaven office? There will be coffee and those lemon bars from the bakery down the street, because good ideas need fuel!

I'm not going to say too much ahead of time on purpose. I want everyone to walk in fresh. I'll just say it has to do with the Elmwood site, and I think there's something really special waiting for us there. I'd love to hear what every one of you sees when you picture it a year from now.

Here's how I'd love it to go:
- Bring your wildest thoughts. Nothing is too big or too weird!
- Omar and Rosa, you've walked the site more than anyone, so I'm counting on your gut reactions.
- Hector, please bring the big sticky-note pads. You know the ones.
- Dmitri and Nadia, I'd love it if you two kept us honest about what our volunteers could actually pull off.
- Kenji, would you capture everything on the whiteboard? Your handwriting is the only legible one among us, haha.

By the end I'd love for us to have a short list of 2-3 directions we're genuinely excited about, so we can pick one to dig into together next month.

Please do come in person if you can. This kind of thing just works so much better when we can bounce ideas off each other in real time. If Thursday is truly impossible, tell me and I'll move it. I want ALL of you there!

Can't wait!!!
Aisha"},{"spec_id":"spec_0097","text":"Westbrook Pictures All-Hands (151) | 30 min | Opal 2.0 status: Goran (schedule recap, no changes), Wes (budget on track), Maeve (new parking badges at front desk), Chidi (wrap date reminder), Raj (payroll cutoff moved to Thu), Vikram (holiday calendar posted) | read slides on shared drive | no Q&A | cameras off fine | host: Cleo"},{"spec_id":"spec_0098","text":"Title: Petrakis contract update (Rafael, Ivan, Tariq)
